name: 清华笑傲江湖
group_note: same XO/TMI-2/ES2/Falcon codebase family as 019 (xo) and 019-1 (xo_final), different quest/game content. WASM pass fixed: (1) classic §8.1 GBK byte-range is_chinese(). (2) logind.lpc check_legal_name()'s unhalved length bound ((< 4)||(> 10), matching a byte-count era, should be (< 2)||(> 5) to match its own 2-5-hanzi prompt). (3) a closure-form input_to((: get_id :), ob) that silently never fires under this driver, switched to the string form input_to("get_id", ob) like every other call site in the same file. (4) §7.52 socket-daemon: removed /secure/daemon/ftpd from secure/etc/preload (undefined socket efuns, 100+ call sites, no non-socket external callers, too large to gut individually). (5) §7.1 master.lpc valid_read()/valid_write() bootstrapping deadlock -- the documented crash-to-segfault form doesn't apply here (this build's driver degrades load_object() failure to a caught 'Object cannot be loaded during compilation' instead of crashing), so the bug surfaced as a SILENT one instead: securityd.lpc's own create() reading its wizlist via read_file() never completes because securityd.lpc itself can never finish compiling (every nested read the compiler needs for its own source/#includes/inherited files recurses back through valid_read(), each attempting load_object(SECURITY_D) again while still mid-compile) -- so wiz_status stays permanently empty and EVERY id, including ones already in the wizlist file, resolves to (player). A previous_object()==securityd-style special case does NOT fix this: during the nested compile-triggered reads previous_object() reports as master itself, never securityd. Fixed with the canonical §7.1 reentrancy flag (added to AGENTS.md as a new documented symptom of §7.1, since the existing writeup only covered the crash form). (6) missing libs/qhxajh/work/log/nosave directory (§7.11, gitignored, not tracked) was crashing log_login()'s log_file() call, breaking get_gender() silently for every registration. Also raised 'maximum evaluation cost' in config.fluffos from 700000 to 5000000000 (the tiny original cap was serializing preload into ~150 individually-interrupted resumptions, ~100s wall time; not itself a bug, just slow). Full registration (id->confirm->Chinese name->admin password->confirm->email->gender) -> enter world -> look -> score -> quit all verified working post-fix and post-formatter, admin id 'fluffos' correctly shows (admin). All 3 §9 formatter blind-spot checks clean (the flagged CJK-spaced strings were pre-existing author content, unchanged by the diff).
